name: Startup Plug

sources.title: Startup Plug homepage - 1000+ curated startup resources

requirements: Curated resource library for startups organized by stage: Idea, Validate, MVP, Business (registration), Team, Funding, Growth, Support
Accepts resources across types: Tools, Blogs/Articles, Podcasts, Books, More - not just products
Submission is a Typeform at thestartupplug.typeform.com/to/QdP01b linked from every 'Submit resource' button
No payment is indicated anywhere on the site
preparation: Resource title, URL, and the startup stage it best serves
A short pitch on why the resource helps founders; audience skews Nigerian/African startups but resources are global
workflow: Open the Typeform: https://thestartupplug.typeform.com/to/QdP01b (linked as '+ Submit resource' in the nav/footer)
Complete the Typeform questions (JS-rendered, not fetchable)
Submit; curation is manual - contact emails listed: info@startupplug.com.ng, thestartupplug@gmail.com
watchFor: Submission channel is entirely Typeform - there is no on-site listing form or account system
Site's latest content is dated (most recent articles ~2023-2024); curation activity level is uncertain
This is a resource library - a listing means being included as a recommended tool/content for a startup stage, not a product profile page
Nigerian (.com.ng) focus - tailor the pitch to early-stage founders
countsAsLive: The resource appears as a card under the relevant stage section (e.g. /build-mvp/, /raise-funds/) or Trending Tools on startupplug.com.ng.
